# Llama Interface Page - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
React web application with Express backend that provides a local interface for interacting with Mistral 7B model using mlx_lm.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React
- Backend: Node.js + Express
- Model: Mistral 7B (via mlx_lm CLI)

## Key Features
- User input for prompts
- Real-time response display
- REST API endpoint for external access (Postman)
- Executes mlx_lm.generate command locally
